notes.title: Bugfixes v1.1.1 + new player
notes.content:
Some small bugfixes + 1 new playable character

[list]
[*] There was a rare chance the game would crash when the player dies
[*] Burn was not affected by token The Expanding Sin
[*] Sin of Second Thoughts did not take Spell Buff cards into account
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes v1.01
notes.content:
Fixed a crash caused by Crown Breaker under certain circumstances.

Fixed an issue where restarting the game from the lobby allowed players to keep their tokens.

Fixed a crash caused by pressing the ESC key in the lobby.

Fixed an issue where the pause menu could be opened during the first token round, showing option buttons without actually pausing the game.
